# Toit à Toit Entretien

> Toit à Toit Entretien is a roof-cleaning and roof-maintenance company serving
> Montréal and surrounding areas. It specializes in roof snow removal, roof drain
> clearing, leaf blowing/removal, and flat-roof flood prevention for residential
> (and some municipal) clients on and around the Island of Montréal. Its
> differentiator is honesty: it tells homeowners the truth about their roof —
> including telling a customer to wait a year before cleaning when she did not yet
> need it. Fully insured, locally owned (owner: Richard Gontarski).

## Contact
- Phone: (514) 993-6897
- Email: toitatoitentretien@gmail.com

- Areas served: Montréal, Saint-Léonard, Ahuntsic-Cartierville, Le Plateau-Mont-Royal, Montréal-Nord, Laval, Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville, Brossard
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/toitatoitentretien

## Services
- Roof snow removal (déneigement de toiture) — clearing snow/ice load; snow is the leading cause of roof collapse in Montréal: https://toitatoitentretien.ca/services/deneigement-toiture
- Roof drain clearing (dégagement de drain) — unblocking roof drains before water damages the membrane: https://toitatoitentretien.ca/services/degagement-drain
- Leaf blowing and removal (soufflage et ramassage de feuilles) — autumn leaf cleanup on flat roofs: https://toitatoitentretien.ca/services/nettoyage-feuilles
- Roof flood prevention (prévention des inondations) — keeping flat roofs draining freely: https://toitatoitentretien.ca/services/prevention-inondations
- Roof renovation (rénovation de toiture): https://toitatoitentretien.ca/services/renovation-toiture
- Custom solutions (solutions personnalisées): https://toitatoitentretien.ca/services/solutions-personnalisees
